name: Flag pawpaw
desc: Flag pawpaw (Asimina obovata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asimina obovata, the bigflower pawpaw, is a shrub or small tree in the custard apple family. It is an endemic native to Florida, where it is found on open sandy hammocks and in dry woods.
